RupeArk is a simple and lightweight app designed to help you back up your call history. You can create a backup in just a few steps and share the backup file through supported apps whenever needed.
The app is easy to use and focuses solely on call history backup. It does not record calls or access conversation content. Call log data is used only to provide the backup and sharing features.
For feedback or support, please contact:

"RupeArk provides features for viewing, searching, filtering, summarizing, backing up, locally saving, and restoring call history. When you actively use a relevant feature, RupeArk requests the Call Log permissions needed to provide that feature. Read Call Log access is used to view, organize, and create backup files. Write Call Log access is used only to restore call records after you select a backup file and confirm the operation. These permissions are not used for purposes unrelated to the features described below."
Please check the agreement before accepting.

"After you grant Call Log access, RupeArk may read existing call record information stored on your device, including: - Phone numbers; - Contact names displayed in the system call history; - Incoming, outgoing, or missed call types; - Call dates and times; - Call duration; - Call status; and - Other call record fields supported by your device. Read Call Log access is used only to: - Display call records stored on your device; - Search, filter, and summarize call records; - Generate a call history backup file at your request; - Display backup record counts, progress, and results; - Save a backup file to a location you select through the system file picker; - Open, review, or share a backup file selected by you; - Read a backup file that you actively select for restoration. Write Call Log access is used only for the restore feature. After you select a backup file, review the relevant information, and confirm the restoration, RupeArk adds supported records from the backup file to your device's system call history and displays the restoration progress and result. RupeArk does not start a restoration automatically or restore call records in the background. The restore feature does not automatically clear or overwrite all existing call records on your device. When you only view, search, filter, summarize, or back up your call history, RupeArk does not modify the original call records stored on your device. RupeArk does not record or listen to calls and does not access call audio or the content of conversations. Except for a restoration that you actively confirm, RupeArk does not automatically add, modify, replace, or delete call records on your device."

RupeArk may request Approximate Location permission to identify your general country or region and determine whether relevant services or regional settings are available to you. RupeArk does not obtain precise location for this purpose and does not: - Determine your exact address; - Track your movements; - Continuously access your location in the background; - Create or retain location history; or - Use location information for targeted advertising or personal profiling. If you decline Approximate Location permission, certain features that depend on regional identification may be unavailable. This will not affect your ability to save call history backup files locally.

RupeArk requests Camera permission only when you actively choose to take a new profile photo. The camera is not activated automatically or accessed in the background. RupeArk does not capture photos or videos without an action initiated by you. A photo you take or select is used only for the profile photo feature and is not used for advertising, marketing, or personal profiling. Declining Camera permission affects only the ability to take a profile photo.

"To support app compatibility, stable operation, and service security, RupeArk may process limited device and technical information, including: - Device model; - Operating system version; - App version; - Language settings; - Network connection status; - Error logs and diagnostic information; - A limited device identifier when required for security checks or technical diagnostics. This information is used only to identify compatibility issues, investigate technical errors, improve app stability, and detect unusual activity that may affect account or service security. RupeArk does not combine this information with Call Log information for targeted advertising or profiling unrelated to the app's functions."

"RupeArk reads relevant call records and generates a backup file only after you actively start the backup process. When saving a backup file, RupeArk opens the Android system file picker so that you can choose the file name and local storage location. RupeArk does not obtain access to all files on your device through this feature. After a backup file is saved, it remains in the location you selected until you move or delete it through your device's file management features. Backup files are not automatically uploaded to RupeArk servers or sent to another person, application, or service without your action. To use the restore feature, you must actively select a backup file through the system file picker and confirm the restoration. The backup file is read and processed locally on your device and is not automatically uploaded to RupeArk servers during restoration. If you choose to share a backup file, RupeArk opens the device's system sharing interface. The file is transferred to a third-party application or service only after you actively select the sharing option and choose a destination. An email provider, cloud storage service, Bluetooth service, messaging application, or other third-party application selected by you may store or process the file under its own privacy policy."
5. Local Backup Storage, Restoration, and Sharing

"You may allow or decline Call Log permission and may revoke previously granted permission at any time through your device settings. If Call Log permission is declined or revoked, the related call history viewing, searching, filtering, summarizing, backup, and restore features will be unavailable. You may also manage Camera and Approximate Location permissions separately through your device settings. Declining or revoking these permissions affects only the features that depend on them. Revoking permissions or uninstalling RupeArk does not automatically delete: - Backup files already saved to your device; - Backup files already shared with third-party applications or services; - Call records already restored to your device's system call history. You must manage these records and files through your device's file management or call history controls, or through the applicable third-party service."

RupeArk is committed to the following: - Accessing required information only when you actively use a relevant feature; - Not continuously reading Call Log information in the background; - Not accessing the camera or continuously obtaining location information in the background; - Not recording calls or accessing call audio or conversation content; - Not selling your personal information or Call Log information; - Not using Call Log information for advertising, marketing, credit evaluation, or unrelated profiling; - Not automatically uploading Call Log information or backup files to RupeArk servers; - Creating, saving, sharing, or restoring a backup only after an action initiated by you; - Restoring records only after you select a backup file and confirm the operation; - Not using the requested permissions for purposes that are not disclosed in this notice. If you do not agree to grant a requested permission, you may decline it. RupeArk will respect your choice, although features that depend on that permission may be unavailable.
RupeArk Permission and Data Use Notice
